prompt: In an anime style library reading room, a girl with pink hair sits on the left, holding a thick blue book open. Next to her in the center, a boy with glasses points at a specific paragraph on the page she holds. On the right, a cat with orange fur sleeps peacefully on a wooden chair. Behind the boy, a woman in a green dress looks at a tall shelf filled with old volumes. In the foreground, a silver pen rests on a scattered pile of notes. The girl is reading intently while the boy gestures toward the text, creating a quiet moment of shared study. The cat remains undisturbed by their presence. There is no electronic device visible in the scene. The warm atmosphere is defined by the soft lines and pastel colors typical of the genre, focusing entirely on these five distinct elements and their simple spatial relationships within the quiet academic space.
